title: Later Western Liang
capsule: Western Liang (西梁, 555-587), also called the Later Liang, was a small successor state to the Liang dynasty founded by Xiao Cha with Western Wei military backing after the fall of Jiangling in 555. It served as a puppet buffer state centred on Jiangling (modern Jingzhou), successively subordinate to Western Wei, Northern Zhou, and the Sui dynasty, which finally absorbed it in 587.
